title: Move the loop concatenation into a StringBuilder
summary: A CSV glued together one plus at a time, until the row count catches up with it.

turns.user: dumping a 100k row csv takes a minute and never comes back. this is the slow bit right?

assistant.body: It is. String is immutable, so every out = out + cell allocates a fresh char array and copies everything written so far into it. The cost grows with the square of the row count. Let's move to a StringBuilder.

turns.user: way faster. while you are in there, each line has a trailing comma. drop it?

assistant.body: Writing it and then trimming is shorter than asking is-this-the-first-cell on every cell, so I shrink the builder by one after the row is done. A row with no cells still needs a guard.
